description: Create an API key for an app. SECURITY: the key must live server-side only (env var, Next.js API routes), never in browser code. If the app has its own users, the server also sends `X-App-User: <user id>` with the key so per-user endpoints know who is acting.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

scopes.description: Permissions recorded on the key: ["read"] or ["read","write"]. Omit to match the app: write when any endpoint accepts POST, PATCH or DELETE.

name: create_app_api_key
